lines.chips: Question 6 in the forge, on our harness. One sentence that needs several tools.
lines.wait: Ask it. The model plans every call itself. About ten seconds, sped up here.
lines.walk00: Model call 1 asks for one tool: find supplier, for Nordic Cell Co.
lines.walk01: The result: Nordic's supplier code, and its certificate marked expired. Voltway Cells is listed too, with a valid one.
lines.walk02: Model call 2 asks for three tools at once: both certificates, and the budget.
lines.walk03: Nordic Cell's UN 38.3 certificate ran out on 30 September. Valid: false.
lines.walk05: Cost centre PRD-07 has one million, one hundred and ninety thousand pounds left.
lines.walk06: Model call 3 prepares the request, as a preview: confirm is false.
lines.walk07: Nothing is saved. The preview shows two hundred and seventy-three thousand, six hundred pounds, and that Daniel must approve it.
lines.walk09: Nordic is out, Voltway is in, the budget is fine, and it asks Emma before it submits. Five tool calls and four model calls, in the order the data forced.
